bitcoin_articles.headline: Cathedra Bitcoin Securityholders Approve Plan of Arrangement with Sphere 3D
bitcoin_articles.summary: Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. securityholders have overwhelmingly approved the proposed statutory plan of arrangement with Sphere 3D Corp.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Cathedra Bitcoin Announces Securityholder Approval of Plan of Arrangement with Sphere 3D
bitcoin_articles.summary: Cathedra Bitcoin Inc. securityholders have overwhelmingly approved the statutory plan of arrangement with Sphere 3D Corp. at a special meeting held on May 15, 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Reports Q1 2026 Financial Results and Debt Elimination
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. announced its first-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting the elimination of all outstanding debt and a total Bitcoin treasury of 15,009 BTC.
